items.title: Community-acquired pneumonia.
items.summary: Comprehensive 2025 review of community-acquired pneumonia covering diagnosis, treatment, and long-term complications including cardiovascular events and cognitive decline.

items.title: Diagnosis and Management of Community-acquired Pneumonia: An Official American Thoracic Society Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.journal: American journal of respiratory and critical care medicine
items.summary: Official 2026 American Thoracic Society clinical practice guideline for diagnosis and management of community-acquired pneumonia in adults.

items.title: Corticosteroids for adult patients hospitalised with non-viral community-acquired pneumonia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 30 RCTs (7,519 patients) evaluating corticosteroids for hospitalized adults with non-viral community-acquired pneumonia.

items.title: Effect of hydrocortisone on mortality in patients with severe community-acquired pneumonia : The REMAP-CAP Corticosteroid Domain Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: REMAP-CAP trial testing hydrocortisone versus control in ICU patients with severe community-acquired pneumonia, analyzing 90-day mortality.

items.title: A Pragmatic Trial of Glucocorticoids for Community-Acquired Pneumonia.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: Pragmatic randomized trial of oral low-dose glucocorticoids for 10 days versus standard care in 18 public hospitals in Kenya for community-acquired pneumonia.

items.title: Low-dose methylprednisolone treatment in critically ill patients with severe community-acquired pneumonia.
items.summary: Double-blind RCT of prolonged low-dose methylprednisolone (40mg/day) in critically ill patients with severe community-acquired pneumonia.

items.title: Duration of antibiotic treatment for community-acquired pneumonia.
items.summary: Review of antibiotic duration for community-acquired pneumonia, confirming non-inferiority of 3-7 day versus longer treatments.

items.title: Antibiotics for community-acquired pneumonia in adult outpatients.
items.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
items.summary: Cochrane systematic review of antibiotics for community-acquired pneumonia in adult outpatients addressing optimal antibiotic treatment.

items.title: Predicting benefit from adjuvant therapy with corticosteroids in community-acquired pneumonia: a data-driven analysis of randomised trials.
items.summary: Individual patient data meta-analysis evaluating heterogeneity of treatment effect for adjuvant corticosteroids on 30-day mortality in CAP.

items.title: Effect of a driving pressure-limiting strategy for patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome secondary to community-acquired pneumonia: the STAMINA randomised clinical trial.
items.summary: STAMINA trial testing driving pressure-limiting strategy versus low PEEP in moderate to severe ARDS secondary to community-acquired pneumonia.

items.title: U.K. Controlled trial of intrapleural streptokinase for pleural infection.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: Double-blind trial of 454 patients with pleural infection randomized to intrapleural streptokinase versus placebo.

items.title: Anaerobic Antibiotic Coverage in Aspiration Pneumonia and the Associated Benefits and Harms: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: Retrospective cohort study comparing limited versus extended anaerobic antibiotic coverage in community-acquired aspiration pneumonia.

items.title: Short treatment duration for community-acquired pneumonia.
Influenza and pneumococcal vaccinations for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD): an evidence-based review.
Ceftaroline fosamil as a potential treatment option for Staphylococcus aureus community-acquired pneumonia in adults.
Ziritaxestat, a Novel Autotaxin Inhibitor, and Lung Function in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: The ISABELA 1 and 2 Randomized Clinical Trials.

canonicalFacts.claim: Community-acquired pneumonia is now recognized as having long-term complications including cardiovascular events, respiratory impairment, and cognitive decline
Short-duration antibiotic treatment (3-7 days) is non-inferior to longer treatments (>7 days) for community-acquired pneumonia
Empirical antibiotic selection is the cornerstone of management for patients with pneumonia
Current guidelines recommend 5-7 days of antibiotic treatment for adults with community-acquired pneumonia
Nucleic acid amplification tests and point-of-care lung ultrasound allow for rapid pathogen detection and personalized treatment

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccinations are recommended for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease

redFlags: Community-acquired pneumonia disproportionately affects vulnerable populations including older people, immunocompromised individuals, and those with chronic conditions
Pleural infection may require specialized drainage procedures beyond standard pneumonia treatment

pipelineDrugs.name: Ceftaroline fosamil
pipelineDrugs.mechanism: Fifth-generation parenteral cephalosporin with broad-spectrum activity against Gram-positive pathogens including MRSA

excludedAgents.name: Intrapleural streptokinase
excludedAgents.reason: Double-blind trial of 454 patients with pleural infection showed no benefit for intrapleural streptokinase versus placebo

excludedAgents.name: Ziritaxestat
excludedAgents.reason: Phase 3 ISABELA trials in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis were terminated early due to lack of efficacy
